method: per-hour decentralized best-response game solved fresh each hour (no learning across days); projected gradient, Jacobi update (s_-i held at previous iteration values)
adaptation: Behrunani et al. 2023 original "cost reduction" is a monetary quantity (revenue from selling surplus in a Stackelberg price game). Absent a price mechanism in our environment, we implement the inner-level equilibrium-seeking mechanism only with the direct energy-unit analog as benefit term: L_i = unmet_energy + wasted_energy (kWh). Each house minimizes J_i = L_i(s) + lambda*(DeltaL_i - mean(DeltaL))^2, DeltaL_i = L_i(0) - L_i(s). This is a mistranslation correction (comfort was never the right quantity for donors); NOT a modification of Behrunani's method.
objective: J_i = L_i + lambda*(DeltaL_i - mean(DeltaL))^2, L_i in kWh
discretization: continuous s in [0,1] solved in-game; rounded to {0.0, 0.5, 1.0} only at execution
topology: ring; donor i shares to recipient (i+1)%10
